hazard: The task-completion check stops running on Stop or SubagentStop, so a task can be claimed complete without fresh gate markers.

argv:
import json,sys
s=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['hooks']
ok=all(any(h['command'].endswith('/.claude/hooks/verify-task-completion.sh') for e in s.get(ev,[]) for h in e['hooks']) for ev in ('Stop','SubagentStop'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
